Lower the end effector from its initial height of 0.4344 to the required grasping height of 0.257, as per the task rules.
Close the gripper to a width of 0.05 to securely hold the free end of the rope.
Drag the grasped end of the rope to (0.4787, -0.1360). This new position is symmetric to the fixed end's y-coordinate, creating a standard U-shape.
